Pergunta: Qual a diferença entre will e going to para o futuro?
Resposta: Will para decisões e previções; going to para planos já firmados.

Pergunta: Complete: I ___ visit my aunt next weekend.
Resposta: am going to

Pergunta: Qual e a estrutura do first conditional?
Resposta: If + present simple, will + base verb: a real and possible condition.

Pergunta: Complete: If it rains, we ___ at home.
Resposta: will stay

Pergunta: Qual e a estrutura do second conditional?
Resposta: If + past simple, would + base verb, for unreal or unlikely situations.

Pergunta: Complete: If I had a car, I ___ to work by bike.
Resposta: would not go

Pergunta: Como formar o passive voice no passado?
Resposta: With was/were followed by the past participle of the verb.

Pergunta: Complete: The windows ___ by the students yesterday.
Resposta: were cleaned

Pergunta: Complete: The report ___ last week.
Resposta: was written

Pergunta: Qual tempo verbal aparece no reported speech?
Resposta: The tense usually goes back: present becomes past, and will becomes would.

Pergunta: Transforme em discurso indireto: I am tired.
Resposta: She said that she was tired.

Pergunta: Transforme em discurso indireto: We will leave now.
Resposta: They said that they would leave then.

Pergunta: Transforme em discurso indireto: He has finished the project.
Resposta: He said that he had finished the project.

Pergunta: Qual connector indica contraste?
Resposta: Although, though, whereas, despite, in spite of.

Pergunta: Complete: ___ it was raining, they went for a walk.
Resposta: Although

Pergunta: Qual connector indica consequencia?
Resposta: Therefore, so, as a result, consequently.

Pergunta: Qual connector indica oposicao entre ideias?
Resposta: However, nevertheless, on the other hand.

Pergunta: Qual frase sobre meio ambiente usa corretamente going to?
Resposta: We are going to recycle more and save water.

Pergunta: Complete: If we reduce plastic, we ___ protect the oceans.
Resposta: will

Pergunta: Qual e uma expressao sobre energia sustentável?
Resposta: We should use more solar and wind power instead of fossil fuels.

Pergunta: Qual frase fala do trabalho e planos futuros?
Resposta: I want to become a nurse, so I am studying biology.

Pergunta: Complete: She is going to ___ her own company.
Resposta: start

Pergunta: Qual é a diferença entre rise e raise?
Resposta: Rise é intransitivo; raise é transitivo, com objeto.

Pergunta: Complete: The temperature will ___ tomorrow.
Resposta: rise

Pergunta: Qual verbo irregular no passado significa ler?
Resposta: Read, pronounced like the word red.

Pergunta: Complete: She ___ to Berlin in 2019.
Resposta: went

Pergunta: Qual verbo irregular significa escrever no passado?
Resposta: Wrote, from write.

Pergunta: Complete: He ___ a famous song last night.
Resposta: sang

Pergunta: Qual frase sobre cinema está no passive voice?
Resposta: The film was directed by a Brazilian director.

Pergunta: Como você expressa opinião em inglês?
Resposta: In my opinion, I think that, as far as I am concerned.

Pergunta: Qual skill e usada para achar informação especifica em um texto longo?
Resposta: Scanning, looking quickly for key words.

Pergunta: Como se faz inferencia em um texto?
Resposta: By connecting clues in the text with what you already know about the topic.

Pergunta: O que significa world Englishes?
Resposta: The existence of many varieties of English linked to places and speakers.

Pergunta: Por que o ingles tem tantas variantes?
Resposta: Because of colonisation, migration, contact between speakers and local communities.

Pergunta: Qual e a diferenca entre accent e dialect?
Resposta: An accent is how you sound; a dialect also includes grammar and vocabulary.
